label: Isidore of Seville (S. ISIDORI, EPISCOPI ET ECCLESIAE DOCTORIS, Die 4 aprilis)

chants.notes: IN. and GR. citation lines share one merged text block on p554 (y266-289); both rows share this bbox because the block's single center point can't be split between two bands.

Printed as a single AL line after IN+GR with no engraved Gradual on this page; in Paschaltide the Alleluia replaces the Gradual cited above it, so this fills the Gradual's slot (al1, part_id 20) rather than the ordinary al slot. Same construct as Die 2 aprilis (S. Francisci de Paola) on this page, spelled out in full there.
